description:
Welcome to TheRenderQ! Everyday I surround myself with technology and gadgets! Everything I get my hands on goes in front of the camera and becomes a high-quality product review or how-to video. I take great pride in creating highly-detailed and easy to understand product videos that help viewers solve tech problems or to make purchase decisions on their next gadget.

If your company has a product you'd like me to review please feel free to contact me! Thanks!

Harlan Yee
Content Creator at TheRenderQ
